negative: Standalone car-seat base

exclude: Standalone bases unable to restrain a child

records.name: Baby Monitors
records.definition: A device primarily enabling a caregiver to remotely observe or listen to a baby or toddler through audio, video or non-health activity notifications.

positive: Nursery video monitor with room-temperature alerts
negative: Infant pulse-oximetry sock
General home security camera

records.subject: physical

include: Baby audio and video observation devices
Caregiving monitors with incidental room-temperature, crying or ordinary movement notifications
exclude: Devices primarily measuring blood oxygen, heart rate, breathing or body temperature
General security cameras
Standalone monitoring subscriptions, mounts or power accessories
boundary.primary_rule: Classify the primary function and measurement object, not age branding or camera presence; health measurements use the applicable Health type.
boundary.residual_rule: If observation versus human-health measurement is unknown, leave unresolved. Travel-source eligibility additionally requires travel or movement use.

records.name: Baby Safety & Childproofing Products

exclude: Complete strollers, carriers and car seats

boundary.primary_rule: Distinguish independent protection or restraint from complete transport devices and dependent parts; travel-source use additionally requires travel or movement facts.
boundary.residual_rule: Group safety products by function when no supported specific type exists; unclear safety function remains unresolved and classification implies no certification.

records.name: Baby Transport Accessories
